sync_mode.manual_hint: Ideal for removable drives or USB keys plugged in occasionally.
sync_mode.startup_hint: Quickly checks and synchronizes the source each time AMSO launches.
sync_mode.interval_hint: Recommended for network shares (NAS, SMB, NFS).
sync_mode.realtime_hint: Immediately detects file additions and changes on local drives.
dialog.source_config_add_desc: Configure the name, location, and synchronization strategy for your audio folder:
dialog.source_config_edit_desc: Modify the name or synchronization strategy for this source:
settings.section_sources_desc: Manage connected audio folders, locations, and automatic synchronization modes:
settings.about_desc: Audio Multi-Source Organizer — Hybrid audio organizer and synchronizer for music lovers.
settings.player_playback_desc: Manage your system's power behavior during audio playback.
settings.prevent_sleep_hint: Keeps the computer awake while audio is playing. As soon as playback stops or pauses, normal power-saving behavior is restored.
settings.sleep_mode_allow_hint: The system and display follow standard Windows power management during playback.
settings.sleep_mode_player_playlist: Prevent sleep on Player and Playlist screens (default)
settings.sleep_mode_player_playlist_hint: The screen and computer remain on while viewing the Player or Playlist. On other screens, the display can turn off to save power while playback continues.
settings.sleep_mode_always_hint: The screen and computer always remain on during audio playback, regardless of the active screen.
settings.player_engine_desc: Information about the underlying multimedia engine (VLC).
settings.player_transitions_desc: Customize how audio tracks transition in your playback queue.
settings.transition_standard_hint: Waits for the current track to finish completely before loading and starting the next one.
settings.transition_gapless_hint: Preloads the next track in buffer memory for an immediate, uninterrupted transition (recommended for albums and live concerts).
settings.transition_crossfade_hint: Smoothly fades out the current track while fading in the next one for a seamless musical atmosphere.
settings.player_effects_desc: Customize the background animation displayed on the Player page during listening.
effects.particles_hint: Gentle glowing particles float and pulse peacefully around the album cover.
effects.waves_hint: Smooth sinusoidal neon curves gently wave to the rhythm of the music.
effects.stars_hint: Slender luminous trails streak across the screen for a modern cosmic vibe.
effects.warp_hint: Immersive warp-speed dive into deep space with stars flying outward to the edges.
effects.warp_dynamic_hint: Immersive warp-speed flight with smooth random direction changes and banking turns through the stars.
effects.aurora_hint: Soft colorful nebulae breathe and radiate a vibrant glowing aura in the background.
effects.bars_hint: Retro LED spectrum analyzer bars dancing at the bottom to the music beat.
effects.bars_full_hint: Giant retro audio spectrum equalizer filling the entire height and width of the player with segmented LEDs and peak dynamics.
effects.none_hint: Classic dark, clean and minimalist background.

To play all your audio formats (MP3, FLAC, OGG, Opus...), AMSO requires VLC audio components.

Would you like AMSO to download and configure them automatically? (~35 MB, no administrator rights required).

• Mutagen — Audio tags and metadata parsing
• PySide6 / Qt — Native cross-platform graphical interface
• SQLite — High-performance database and indexing
• VideoLAN LibVLC — Multi-format high-fidelity playback engine
